title: That howl! Will linger on lattices of our soul, collapsing inward until the final bell tolls. #smallpoems
summary: That howl! Will linger on lattices of our soul, collapsing inward until the final bell tolls. #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
That howl!
Will linger
on lattices of our
soul,
collapsing
inward
until the final
bell tolls.
#smallpoems
